title: Slow Click Nuanced
vars: The original fast click rides on the front of the slow one: a crisp edge, then the slow body.
The slow click, then click 4 slowed the same way, quieter, 140 ms later. A mechanism with two parts.
Three tiny slowed fragments after the main hit, each softer, 80 ms apart: parts settling.
A 42 Hz thump under the start, a third of a second. Felt more than heard on headphones; lost on a phone speaker.
A faint band of noise rises behind the click and is gone within a second.
Edge, two stages, after-rattle and weight together, each quieter, in a slightly bigger room.
